name: Foundry Indexes
summary: project.indexes.create_or_update registers an Azure AI Search index as a project-level resource, queried from a BYOM-routed agent via AzureAISearchTool.
description: `project.indexes.create_or_update(AzureAISearchIndex(...))` registers an Azure AI Search index for use by Foundry agents, and `AzureAISearchTool` lets a BYOM-routed Prompt Agent query that index. This solves retrieval over a customer's search index while the agent's orchestrator model is routed through APIM AI Gateway.
notes:
Verified end-to-end via `AzureAISearchIndex` plus `AzureAISearchTool` on a BYOM-prefixed Prompt Agent. See `test.py`.

Live proof used ai-gateway-pe-testing on 2026-07-15 with APIM-only routing, no account-local model deployments, and Basic-SKU AI Search. Supported query paths are `simple`, `semantic`, `vector`, `vector_simple_hybrid`, and `vector_semantic_hybrid`; vector and hybrid paths require an index with matching capabilities. This is the lower-level Indexes surface, not Foundry IQ Knowledge Bases (`knowledge-bases`).
